tools.name: calculate_lottery_payout
tools.description: Estimate taxes and withholding on a known lottery cash prize. Input dollars; result integer cents. Bundled 2026 rules.

tools.name: compare_lump_sum_annuity
tools.description: Compare a published cash option with 30 growing annuity payments after taxes, including present value and break-even rate.

tools.description: Estimate one equal member’s cash prize, taxes and withholding. Each member is assumed to have the specified tax profile.

tools.name: calculate_lottery_odds
tools.description: Calculate jackpot coverage for distinct combinations in one drawing and optional before-tax expected ticket return.
